description: CR 115.1 / 603.3d / 608.2h Necrotic Plague: the dead creature's controller chooses a creature one of their opponents controls, and the Plague returns under its own controller's control attached to it
note: Bob owns the Plague and alice controls it, enchanting bob's Bears, so the granted trigger sacrifices them on bob's upkeep and the Plague goes to bob's graveyard. Bob, the Bears' controller by last-known information, announces the target of alice's trigger: an engine asking alice raises an unscheduled prompt. His own Piker is refused, as it would be offered were the opponents alice's; he takes alice's own Giant, which a target relative to alice would refuse (ruling 2010-08-15). The Plague comes back from bob's graveyard under alice, its controller, not bob, its owner, attached to the Giant.
